summary: Iteration 6 blog + SEO overhaul verified end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest passing (blog list/filter/detail/404, iteration-5 regression on /estimate + /leads + admin analytics + referral progress, robots.txt + sitemap.xml + SEO tags in / html). Frontend: BlogList renders 6 cards, category filter chip 'By Visa' narrows to 2 cards, nav-blog present, sidebar-cta href='/#estimator', blog-cta primary navigates to /#estimator, markdown h2/ul/table/blockquote all rendered, blog-share present, unknown slug renders 'not found', Landing page shows 3 landing-blog-grid cards + landing-blog-all -> /blog, FAQPage JSON-LD present (3 ld+json scripts). No blocker issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Review request mentions the slug 'aussie-super-back' but the actual seeded slug for the main article is 'how-to-claim-australian-super-refund-2026-guide'. Wording mismatch in the request only; implementation is consistent and both blog card link and BlogPosting JSON-LD resolve. Consider adding a short canonical slug alias if that URL is intended for marketing.
blog_seed.py is loaded only when the collection is empty. If content ever changes the seed will not re-run — document a re-seed script or add a version/hash check.
list_blog_posts runs a full aggregation for categories on every request (small collection today, fine, but cache once daily as blog grows).
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeded 6 blog posts on startup (blog_seed.SEED_BLOG_POSTS). No additional seed data created by tests. One test lead 'TEST_reg@example.com' inserted via /api/leads regression test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Blog endpoints live at /api/blog/posts (list with category/tag filters, returns categories aggregate) and /api/blog/posts/{slug}. Full markdown content only returned by the /{slug} endpoint. Frontend BlogList: [data-testid='blog-grid'], cards [data-testid^='blog-card-']. BlogPost: [data-testid='blog-content'|'blog-cta'|'blog-cta-primary'|'sidebar-cta'|'blog-share']. Landing: [data-testid='landing-blog-grid'|'landing-blog-all'|'nav-blog']. robots.txt disallows /admin, sitemap.xml lists blog posts. Iteration-5 payload shape for /estimate and /leads uses input_mode in ('balance','earnings') and visa_type in ('working_holiday','other_temp') — /leads also requires first_name, whatsapp_number, estimated_refund. Rate limit 5/hr on /leads.
